name: Protection (Asylum)

qualifying_event.description: Applicants must contact the police and request protection, registering at the National Arrival Centre in Råde (near Oslo, arranging their own travel there). They stay up to 21 days for police interviews, identity/fingerprint registration, and tuberculosis/health screening before their application is processed.
qualifying_event.evidence_hint: In-person registration with police at the National Arrival Centre; identification documents where available; interview.

requirements.blocker_text: Must meet the refugee or protection-need definition. Applicants from countries on Norway's 'safe country of origin' list may have their applications rejected within 48 hours; applicants who passed through another Dublin-procedure country may be returned there without a full UDI interview.

evidence_required.document: Police registration at the National Arrival Centre (Råde)

outcome.duration_length: not confirmed to tier-1 precision in this pass -- see notes

sources.title: UDI -- Applying for protection (asylum) in Norway: National Arrival Centre registration process, 21-day initial stay, 48-hour safe-country rejections, Dublin-procedure returns without full interview
